question: Must this PR provide a real Windows or Crabbox cleanup run before leaving draft, or are its mocked Windows tests sufficient for merge review?
rationale: The branch changes OS-level process termination semantics, and its own platform note says the mocked coverage does not replace repository CI and Crabbox verification.

options.title: Require real runtime proof
options.body: Require a redacted Windows or Crabbox run demonstrating a failed or stalled termination helper, bounded cleanup, preserved primary error, and no disclosed command or environment secrets.

options.title: Accept mocked coverage
options.body: Allow merge review to proceed using the focused mocked Windows tests and green verify check without additional platform evidence.

recommendation.title: Require real runtime proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted Windows or Crabbox run demonstrating a failed or stalled termination helper, bounded cleanup, preserved primary error, and no disclosed command or environment secrets.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member owns the current focused implementation and is the best available person to coordinate the stated platform verification.
